say:1:1411428001:1.text: I'm a little curious, Baelran. Don't you think the terms you offered Zanie are a bit too generous?
say:1:1411428001:1.source_cn: 巴赫朗，我有点好奇，你刚刚给祖娅提供的条件，是不是有些...

choice_prompt:2:1411428001.text: I'm a little curious, Baelran. Don't you think the terms you offered Zanie are a bit too generous?
choice_prompt:2:1411428001.source_cn: 巴赫朗，我有点好奇，你刚刚给祖娅提供的条件，是不是有些太优厚了啊？

say:3:1411428002:0.text: I do have my fair share of charitable work, but rest assured, the deal I just made wasn't an act of kindness.
say:3:1411428002:0.source_cn: 我确实有自己的慈善事业，不过我可以保证，刚刚的口头合约...
say:3:1411428002:0.male: I do have my fair share of charitable work, but rest assured, the deal I just made wasn't an act of kindness.
say:3:1411428002:0.female: I do have my fair share of charitable work, but rest assured, the deal I just made wasn't an act of kindness.

say:4:1411428004:1.text: If being a considerate business partner and refraining from excessive profit-seeking is considered generous, then it seems that the business practices of today are a bit harsh.
say:4:1411428004:1.source_cn: 如果“体谅生意伙伴”“不追求极端剥削性的利润”就属于优...

say:5:1411428005:0.text: Yes, but that being said, most people would choose to walk away to minimize risk.
say:5:1411428005:0.source_cn: 话是这么说，但大部分人为了规避风险也会放弃啊。

say:6:1411428006:0.text: You're not worried about the risks, and you don't care about profits. I'm starting to think you're not a serious businessman.
say:6:1411428006:0.source_cn: 像你这样又不在意风险，对利润也说让就让，感觉不怎么认真呢……

say:7:1411428007:1.text: Yes, well, Elijah and Lailah always say that when it comes to business or being a Celestial, I'm subpar at best.
say:7:1411428007:1.source_cn: 啊，这一点伊莱亚和莱拉也经常说，做生意和当半神都是不上...

say:8:1411428008:0.text: Still, I believe that in all things, moderation is key. It makes life easier, not just for others, but for yourself as well.
say:8:1411428008:0.source_cn: 不过，我还是觉得，无论做什么事都不要太极端，这样对人对...

choice_prompt:9:1411428008.text: Still, I believe that in all things, moderation is key. It makes life easier, not just for others, but for yourself as well.
choice_prompt:9:1411428008.source_cn: 不过，我还是觉得，无论做什么事都不要太极端，这样对人对己都更轻松。

say:10:1411428009:1.text: Well, among all the other Celestials I've met, I might be the only one who sees things this way.
say:10:1411428009:1.source_cn: 是的，至少在认识的半神里，应该只有我一个人这么想。
say:10:1411428009:1.male: Well, among all the other Celestials I've met, I might be the only one who sees things this way.
say:10:1411428009:1.female: Well, among all the other Celestials I've met, I might be the only one who sees things this way.

say:11:1411428011:0.text: What changed me was the brutality of the Divine War...
say:11:1411428011:0.source_cn: 要说产生这个想法的契机，应该还是惨烈的神魔大战吧。

say:12:1411428012:1.text: Among us Celestials, the war left its mark. Some grew to hate the Hypogeans even more, while others chose to keep that bitterness quietly locked away.
say:12:1411428012:1.source_cn: 只说我们半神，在战后，有人对恶魔的憎恶愈发强烈，也有人...

say:13:1411428013:1.text: I found myself utterly spent, both physically and mentally. At that point, all I wished for was peace.
say:13:1411428013:1.source_cn: 不过我就是身心俱疲，因此反而不愿意多去思考，只想休息了。

say:14:1411428014:0.text: That explains why you're retired. So, business and charity are just pastimes for you now?
say:14:1411428014:0.source_cn: 怪不得你说自己是退休，所以做生意和慈善对你来说是消遣？

say:15:1411428015:0.text: Yes, a little bit. I mostly just let things unfold naturally. Earning a profit is nice, but the real joy comes when I get to help someone along the way.
say:15:1411428015:0.source_cn: 是啊，基本上也是顺其自然，有盈利固然好，但能帮到别人也...

choice_prompt:16:1411428015.text: Yes, a little bit. I mostly just let things unfold naturally. Earning a profit is nice, but the real joy comes when I get to help someone along the way.
choice_prompt:16:1411428015.source_cn: 是啊，基本上也是顺其自然，有盈利固然好，但能帮到别人也算是意外之喜。

say:17:1411428016:2.text: Once this is all settled, I'll likely return to my glamorous life as a part-time investor and wannabe philanthropist.
say:17:1411428016:2.source_cn: 等眼下的事结束后，多半还是会回去继续我那半吊子的事业吧。
say:17:1411428016:2.male: Once this is all settled, I'll likely return to my glamorous life as a part-time investor and wannabe philanthropist.
say:17:1411428016:2.female: Once this is all settled, I'll likely return to my glamorous life as a part-time investor and wannabe philanthropist.

say:18:1411428017:1.text: But as a Celestial, I have a responsibility to uphold. To ignore the Hypogean now, when she stands before me, would be a grave neglect of duty.
say:18:1411428017:1.source_cn: 不过如今，我姑且身为半神，也有自己应尽的职责，恶魔出现...
say:18:1411428017:1.male: But as a Celestial, I have a responsibility to uphold. To ignore the Hypogean now, when she stands before me, would be a grave neglect of duty.
say:18:1411428017:1.female: But as a Celestial, I have a responsibility to uphold. To ignore the Hypogean now, when she stands before me, would be a grave neglect of duty.

say:19:1411428018:1.text: And besides, it's a reunion with our dear old Merlin! Why don't we team up again, celebrate, and pick up right where we left off?
say:19:1411428018:1.source_cn: 再说，这不是还与亲爱的梅林重逢了吗，作为庆祝，联手重操...
say:19:1411428018:1.male: And besides, it's a reunion with our dear old Merlin! Why don't we team up again, celebrate, and pick up right where we left off?
say:19:1411428018:1.female: And besides, it's a reunion with our dear old Merlin! Why don't we team up again, celebrate, and pick up right where we left off?

choice_prompt:20:1411428018.text: And besides, it's a reunion with our dear old Merlin! Why don't we team up again, celebrate, and pick up right where we left off?
choice_prompt:20:1411428018.source_cn: 再说，这不是还与亲爱的梅林重逢了吗，作为庆祝，联手重操旧业如何？
choice_prompt:20:1411428018.male: And besides, it's a reunion with our dear old Merlin! Why don't we team up again, celebrate, and pick up right where we left off?
choice_prompt:20:1411428018.female: And besides, it's a reunion with our dear old Merlin! Why don't we team up again, celebrate, and pick up right where we left off?

say:21:1411428019:1.text: Yes, I can't wait to enjoy our next battle.
say:21:1411428019:1.source_cn: 棒极了，我已经迫不及待地打算享受接下来的战斗了。
say:21:1411428019:1.male: Yes, I can't wait to enjoy our next battle.
say:21:1411428019:1.female: Yes, I can't wait to enjoy our next battle.

say:22:1411428021:1.text: Besides, no matter how you look at her, Kulu is still a little girl.
say:22:1411428021:1.source_cn: 而且，那个库露露……怎么看都只是个小丫头。

say:23:1411428022:0.text: So, let's not overthink this. We'll find her and resolve the issue calmly. No need for drama.
say:23:1411428022:0.source_cn: 不用太上心，找到人后简简单单地解决掉就好了。

say:25:1411428023:1.text: Lailah, isn't it a dereliction of duty for a Celestial to be soft on Hypogeans?
say:25:1411428023:1.source_cn: 会对恶魔心慈手软的半神，还不算失职吗，莱拉？

say:26:1411428024:0.text: I guess, but compared to a Celestial who completely ignores Hypogeans, being lenient doesn't seem like such a breach of duty.
say:26:1411428024:0.source_cn: 比起对恶魔毫不上心的半神来说，或许不算失职吧，伊莱亚。

say:27:1411428025:0.text: Fine, I'm sorry, alright? I just think that little girl is a bit too weak to be lumped in with the rest of the Hypogeans.
say:27:1411428025:0.source_cn: 好了好了，我道歉，我道歉，我只是觉得那小丫头在恶魔里也...

say:28:1411428026:0.text: Since she poses no real threat and Merlin is with us, there's no need to worry too much about the enemy.
say:28:1411428026:0.source_cn: 既然没什么威胁，又有梅林坐镇，就不必太如临大敌。
say:28:1411428026:0.male: Since she poses no real threat and Merlin is with us, there's no need to worry too much about the enemy.
say:28:1411428026:0.female: Since she poses no real threat and Merlin is with us, there's no need to worry too much about the enemy.

say:34:1411430001:0.text: How dare you guys mock me?!
say:34:1411430001:0.source_cn: 你、你们！你们居然敢这么嘲笑我！

say:35:1411430002:1.text: Who are you calling <shk>weak</shk>?! And what do you mean "<shk>no real threat</shk>"?! You really think you can <shk>take me down that easy</shk>?!
say:35:1411430002:1.source_cn: 什么叫<shk>弱！</shk>什么叫<shk>没有威...
say:35:1411430002:1.male: Who are you calling <shk>weak</shk>?! And what do you mean "<shk>no real threat</shk>"?! You really think you can <shk>take me down that easy</shk>?!
say:35:1411430002:1.female: Who are you calling <shk>weak</shk>?! And what do you mean "<shk>no real threat</shk>"?! You really think you can <shk>take me down that easy</shk>?!

say:36:1411430003:1.text: <shk>Ahhh!</shk> I want to kill you all! You're dead!
say:36:1411430003:1.source_cn: <shk>啊啊啊——我生气了！我生气了！</shk>我...

choice_prompt:37:1411430003.text: <shk>Ahhh!</shk> I want to kill you all! You're dead!
choice_prompt:37:1411430003.source_cn: <shk>啊啊啊——我生气了！我生气了！</shk>我绝对不会放过你们！

say:38:1411430004:1.text: I'm writing down everything you guys said! This is evidence!
say:38:1411430004:1.source_cn: 是你们先说我坏话！我肯定会记下来的！这是证据！
say:38:1411430004:1.male: I'm writing down everything you guys said! This is evidence!
say:38:1411430004:1.female: I'm writing down everything you guys said! This is evidence!

say:39:1411430006:1.text: Do I look like some mortal to you?! I'm a powerful Hypogean! I'll never forgive anyone who snubs me, let alone people who spread this... this... What's the word I'm looking for?
say:39:1411430006:1.source_cn: 我这样伟大的恶魔，绝对不会放过一星半点的仇恨，更不要说...

say:42:1411430008:1.text: Yes, slander! I've already written down all the things you were saying behind my back. It's time for me to get revenge!
say:42:1411430008:1.source_cn: 对！你们背后的诋毁，我已经记下了！我必须要狠狠复仇！

choice_prompt:43:1411430008.text: Yes, slander! I've already written down all the things you were saying behind my back. It's time for me to get revenge!
choice_prompt:43:1411430008.source_cn: 对！你们背后的诋毁，我已经记下了！我必须要狠狠复仇！

say:44:1411430009:1.text: No, I'm not as trashy as you dweebs! I'm a stand-up Hypogean!
say:44:1411430009:1.source_cn: 我才没有你们这么阴暗！我可是堂堂正正的凶暴恶魔！
say:44:1411430009:1.male: No, I'm not as trashy as you dweebs! I'm a stand-up Hypogean!
say:44:1411430009:1.female: No, I'm not as trashy as you dweebs! I'm a stand-up Hypogean!

say:45:1411430010:1.text: I'm going to do evil, awful things to you. You'll suffer horribly! My revenge will be tortuous!
say:45:1411430010:1.source_cn: 我会用恶魔的方式，邪恶！凶暴！强大地向你们复仇！
say:45:1411430010:1.male: I'm going to do evil, awful things to you. You'll suffer horribly! My revenge will be tortuous!
say:45:1411430010:1.female: I'm going to do evil, awful things to you. You'll suffer horribly! My revenge will be tortuous!

say:46:1411430011:1.text: Lady Kulu, do you mean torturous...? Oh, never mind...
say:46:1411430011:1.source_cn: ……库露露大人，强大这个词不是这么用……呃算了。

say:47:1411430012:1.text: I'm going to teach you all a lesson you'll never forget!
say:47:1411430012:1.source_cn: 我一定会给你们颜色瞧瞧，让你们心服口服！

say:48:1411430013:1.text: Yes, Lady Kulu will make you regret your insults!
say:48:1411430013:1.source_cn: 是的！库露露大人一定会让你们悔恨交加，追悔莫及，悔之晚矣！

say:49:1411430014:1.text: Just wait! I'm going to create the biggest bomb in the world!
say:49:1411430014:1.source_cn: 走着瞧吧，我要做一个前所未有的超级大炸弹！！！

narration:54:14014041:0.text: Kulu springs out after eavesdropping on you. Upset by what she hears, she drops a bomb and runs off.
narration:54:14014041:0.source_cn: 偷听你们说话的库露露一跃而出。又因为你们的话而丢下炸弹...
narration:54:14014041:0.male: Kulu springs out after eavesdropping on you. Upset by what she hears, she drops a bomb and runs off.
narration:54:14014041:0.female: Kulu springs out after eavesdropping on you. Upset by what she hears, she drops a bomb and runs off.

choice:43:0:1.text: You want to slander us too?
choice:43:0:1.male: You want to slander us too?
choice:43:0:1.female: You want to slander us too?

say:55:1411430005:1.text: What do you mean eavesdropping?! You were all insulting me! I'm writing this down!
say:55:1411430005:1.source_cn: 什么叫偷听！你们先说我坏话，我只是记下来而已！

say:55:1411430005:1.female: What do you mean eavesdropping?! You were all insulting me! I'm writing this down!

say:57:1411428020:1.text: Ha! Leave it to me, then. After all, we can't just have a mage charging into battle, can we?
say:57:1411428020:1.source_cn: 哈哈哈，那就交给我吧，毕竟也不应该让魔法师冲锋陷阵嘛。
say:57:1411428020:1.male: Ha! Leave it to me, then. After all, we can't just have a mage charging into battle, can we?
say:57:1411428020:1.female: Ha! Leave it to me, then. After all, we can't just have a mage charging into battle, can we?

choice:20:1:2.text: Hey, I need my rest too.
choice:20:1:2.male: Hey, I need my rest too.
choice:20:1:2.female: Hey, I need my rest too.

choice:16:0:1.text: What are your plans after this?
choice:16:0:1.male: What are your plans after this?
choice:16:0:1.female: What are your plans after this?

say:58:1411428010:1.text: Well, my thinking has changed over time. For a while, I shared the same views as the other Celestials.
say:58:1411428010:1.source_cn: 唔，也是有转变过程的，过去我的想法和其他半神都差不多。
say:58:1411428010:1.male: Well, my thinking has changed over time. For a while, I shared the same views as the other Celestials.
say:58:1411428010:1.female: Well, my thinking has changed over time. For a while, I shared the same views as the other Celestials.

say:59:1411428003:0.text: No, I'm still anticipating a return on this investment. I'm simply allowing it to return to me gradually over time.
say:59:1411428003:0.source_cn: 不不，我仍然在期待着这份投资能给予我的回报，只是我允许...
say:59:1411428003:0.male: No, I'm still anticipating a return on this investment. I'm simply allowing it to return to me gradually over time.
say:59:1411428003:0.female: No, I'm still anticipating a return on this investment. I'm simply allowing it to return to me gradually over time.

choice:2:1:2.text: Doesn't seem like good business to me.
choice:2:1:2.male: Doesn't seem like good business to me.
choice:2:1:2.female: Doesn't seem like good business to me.
